records.courseDetails: The Executive MBA connects strategy, leadership, finance, marketing and research with organisational design, workplace behaviour and entrepreneurship. Learners apply these subjects to resource decisions, team leadership and business growth.
outcomes: Evaluate strategic options as markets and organisational priorities change.
Choose leadership methods that support innovation and coordinated teams.
Relate workforce policies to engagement and business objectives.
Use financial planning when allocating resources and assessing investment.
Build marketing decisions around market conditions and customer insight.
Investigate business problems through structured research and data.
Apply management principles to organisational performance.
Evaluate organisational structures and operating processes.
Assess how workplace behaviour affects motivation and collaboration.
Develop commercially viable ideas and entrepreneurial responses.
